part1_desc: 第 1–23 步：跟站长学 How long 提问，学会问“持续了多久”。
part2_desc: 第 24–47 步：独立判断造纸术资料，再挑战完形填空（油纸伞的故事）和跨单元混考。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：How long 提问句型、for/since 回答；挑战段含完形填空（中考题型）与跨单元混考（被动语态、最高级、been/gone）。Unit 6 Ancient stories 主题。

steps.title: 端午节的故事
steps.teach_html:
上期长城的故事播完，听众问：端午节过了多少年？站长说：这期讲端午节 (the Dragon Boat Festival) 的故事！

要问“持续了多久”，英文用 How long 开头提问。

steps.title: How long 提问
steps.teach_html:
How long 意思是“多久”，问的是一段时间。

结构：How long + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词？

How long have you lived here?（你在这里住了多久？）

steps.title: 用 for 回答
steps.teach_html:
问多久，经常用 for + 时间段 回答：

—How long have you learned English?（你学英语多久了？）
—For three years.（三年。）

steps.title: 用 since 回答
steps.teach_html:
也可以用 since + 时间点 回答：

—How long has he lived here?（他在这里住了多久？）
—Since 2020.（从2020年起。）

steps.title: 屈原与端午节
steps.teach_html:
Qu Yuan（屈原）是中国古代的诗人。人们赛龙舟纪念他。

remember 是“记得、纪念”。People have celebrated the Dragon Boat Festival for over 2,000 years.（人们庆祝端午节已经2000多年了。）

steps.title: 龙舟赛
steps.teach_html:
They have dragon boat races since ancient times.（自古以来人们就赛龙舟。）

dragon boat race 是“龙舟赛”。注意：since + 时间点 ancient times。

steps.title: How long 和 When
steps.teach_html:
别弄混：How long 问“多久”（一段时间），When 问“何时”（时间点）。

When did you come?（你何时来的？）—Yesterday.（昨天。）
How long have you stayed?（你待了多久？）—For a week.（一周。）

steps.title: 小结
steps.teach_html:
小结：How long + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词？问多久；回答用 for + 时间段 或 since + 时间点。

下面站长带着你练。资料卡在上面，做题时对照着看。

steps.title: 先看资料
steps.teach_html:
这是端午节的资料卡。做题时对照着看：端午节在六月，人们纪念屈原，有龙舟赛，人们庆祝它已经2000多年了。

下面站长带着你练 How long 提问。

wrong_feedback.C: When 问“何时”，问“多久”用 How long。
wrong_feedback.D: Where 问“哪里”，问“多久”用 How long。

steps.title: 学了三年

steps.explain: —How long have you learned English? —For three years.

wrong_feedback.A: How 一个词不够，问“多久”用 How long。
wrong_feedback.C: When 问“何时”，这里问“多久”。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 从2020年
steps.stem: —How long has he stayed? —___ 2020.

steps.explain: —How long has he stayed? —Since 2020.

wrong_feedback.A: 2020 是时间点，时间点用 since，不用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: from 是“从”，回答“自从”用 since。

wrong_feedback.A: since 后面跟时间点，“两千多年”是时间段，用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: in 不能表示“持续”，用 for。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: remember 的意思
steps.stem: The word "remember" means ___.

steps.explain: remember 意思是“记得”，这里指“纪念”。

wrong_feedback.B: 忘记是 forget。remember 是“记得”。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 问何时
steps.stem: ___ did you come here?
steps.help: “何时”用哪个疑问词？
steps.explain: When did you come here?

wrong_feedback.A: How long 问“多久”，问“何时”用 When。
wrong_feedback.B: How 问“怎样”，问“何时”用 When。
wrong_feedback.C: What 问“什么”，问“何时”用 When。

steps.stem: People have celebrated it ___ ancient times.

steps.explain: People have celebrated it since ancient times.

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 从小时候
steps.stem: —How long have they known each other? —___ they were children.
steps.help: since 可跟句子。
steps.explain: —How long have they known each other? —Since they were children.

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟时间段，这里“自从小时候”用 since。
wrong_feedback.D: in 后面跟年份月份，这里用 since。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 工作五年
steps.stem: She has worked here ___ five years.
steps.help: “五年”是时间段。
steps.explain: She has worked here for five years.

wrong_feedback.B: since 后面跟时间点，“五年”是时间段，用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: in 不能表示“持续”，用 for。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 问多久
steps.stem: ___ long has he lived here?
steps.task: 只写 How、What、When 中的一个。
steps.help: “多久”用 How long。
steps.explain: How long has he lived here?

common_errors.say: When 问“何时”，问“多久”用 How。
What 问“什么”，问“多久”用 How。
Where 问“哪里”，问“多久”用 How。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 等了两小时
steps.scene: 问等了多久，回答两小时。
steps.stem: —How long have you waited? —___ two hours.
steps.help: 两小时是时间段。
steps.explain: —How long have you waited? —For two hours.

common_errors.say: 两小时是时间段，用 for。
from 是“从”，回答“持续了两小时”用 For。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: remember 的中文
steps.stem: 写出 remember 的中文意思。
steps.help: 人们 remember 屈原。
steps.explain: remember 的中文是“记得”。

common_errors.say: “忘记”是 forget。remember 是“记得”。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 从周一
steps.stem: He has been here ___ Monday.
steps.help: 周一是时间点。
steps.explain: He has been here since Monday.

common_errors.say: 周一是时间点，用 since。
from 只说“从”，“自从周一起”用 since。

steps.reading: The Dragon Boat Festival is in June. People remember Qu Yuan. They have dragon boat races. People have celebrated it for over 2,000 years.

steps.title: 待了多久
steps.stem: ___ long have they stayed?
steps.task: 只写 How、What、When 中的一个。
steps.help: “多久”用 How long。
steps.explain: How long have they stayed?

common_errors.say: When 问“何时”，这里问“多久”，用 How。
What 问“什么”，问“多久”用 How。

steps.title: 新任务：独立判断
steps.teach_html:
新任务来了：这次是造纸术 (paper-making) 的资料。中国人很早发明了纸，呼应咱们之前发明单元讲过的内容。

资料在上面。这次你自己看、自己答，站长不提示了。

记住：How long 问多久；for + 时间段，since + 时间点。
steps.reading: Chinese people invented paper long ago. People have used paper for over 2,000 years. They have made paper since ancient times.

steps.title: 用纸多久
steps.stem: ___ long have people used paper?
steps.help: 先想一想：这句问的是一段时间，还是一个时间点、一个地点。
steps.explain: How long have people used paper?

wrong_feedback.B: What 问“什么”，问“多久”用 How。
wrong_feedback.C: When 问“何时”（时间点），这里问的是“用了多久”（一段时间），用 How。
wrong_feedback.D: Where 问“哪里”，问“多久”用 How。

steps.reading: Chinese people invented paper long ago. People have used paper for over 2,000 years. They have made paper since ancient times.

steps.title: 自古以来
steps.stem: They have made paper ___ ancient times.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的 ancient times：它是一个时间点。
steps.explain: They have made paper since ancient times.

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间；ancient times 是时间点，用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: from 只说“从……”，“自从……起一直到现在”用 since。
wrong_feedback.D: at 后面跟时刻（如 at 7 o'clock），这里用 since。

steps.reading: Chinese people invented paper long ago. People have used paper for over 2,000 years. They have made paper since ancient times.

steps.title: invent 的意思
steps.stem: The word "invent" means ___.
steps.help: 想一想：中国人把纸从无到有造出来，这个动作叫什么。
steps.explain: invent 意思是“发明”。

wrong_feedback.B: “发现”是找到本来就有的东西；invent 是造出新东西，是“发明”。

steps.reading: Chinese people invented paper long ago. People have used paper for over 2,000 years. They have made paper since ancient times.

steps.title: 存了十年
steps.scene: 她这本旧书存了十年了。
steps.stem: She has kept the old book ___ ten years.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的 ten years：它是一段时间。
steps.explain: She has kept the old book for ten years.

wrong_feedback.A: since 后面跟时间点；ten years 是一段时间，用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: from 是“从”，表示“持续了……”用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: in 不能接一段时间表示“持续了多久”，用 for。

steps.reading: Chinese people invented paper long ago. People have used paper for over 2,000 years. They have made paper since ancient times.

steps.title: 从八岁
steps.stem: He has collected stamps ___ he was eight.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的是什么：这里跟的是一整句话。
steps.explain: He has collected stamps since he was eight.

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间；这里跟的是一句话 he was eight，用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: from 是“从”，“自从……起”用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: after 只表示“在……之后”的先后关系，不能表示“自从那时起一直到现在”；这里用 since。

steps.reading: Chinese people invented paper long ago. People have used paper for over 2,000 years. They have made paper since ancient times.

steps.title: 古桥六百年
steps.scene: 这座古桥在这里已经六百多年了。
steps.stem: The old bridge has stood here ______ more than 600 years.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的 more than 600 years：它是一段时间。
steps.explain: The old bridge has stood here for more than 600 years.

wrong_feedback.A: since 后面跟时间点；more than 600 years 是一段时间，用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: from 是“从”，表示“持续了……”用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: in 不能接一段时间表示“持续了多久”，用 for。

steps.title: invent 的中文
steps.stem: 写出 invent 的中文意思。
steps.help: 中国人 invent 了纸——把这个词的意思写出来。
steps.explain: invent 的中文是“发明”。

common_errors.say: “发现”是找到本来就有的东西；invent 是造出新东西，中文是“发明”。
造纸是 make paper 这个动作；invent 这个词本身的意思是“发明”。

steps.reading: Chinese people invented paper long ago. People have used paper for over 2,000 years. They have made paper since ancient times.

steps.title: 收藏老照片
steps.scene: 博物馆从 2015 年起收藏这些老照片。
steps.stem: The museum has kept these old photos ______ 2015.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的 2015：它是一个时间点。
steps.explain: The museum has kept these old photos since 2015.

common_errors.say: 2015 是时间点（年份），for 后面跟一段时间；时间点用 since。

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形短文
steps.teach_html:
挑战来了：完形填空。下面是油纸伞手艺人林师傅的故事。先把短文读一遍，知道大概讲什么，再逐个空选。

Mr Lin makes oil-paper umbrellas in a small town. He has made them __1__ 1985. "I fell in love with this old craft when I was a boy," he says. People have used oil-paper umbrellas in China __2__ a long time. He has taught his son the craft, and now his son works with him. "Have you __3__ seen an umbrella made by hand?" he asks visitors. Last year, a TV station __4__ a short film about him. Many people watched it, and more visitors have come to his shop since then.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第1空
steps.stem: He has made them ______ 1985.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的 1985：它是一个年份（时间点），还是一段时间。
steps.explain: 1985 是时间点，“自从 1985 年起”用 since。

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间；1985 是时间点（年份），用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: from 只说从哪一年开始，不表示一直持续到现在；“自从 1985 年起”用 since。
wrong_feedback.D: after 是“在……之后”，只说先后，不表示一直持续到现在；“自从 1985 年起”用 since。

steps.reading: Mr Lin makes oil-paper umbrellas in a small town. He has made them __1__ 1985. "I fell in love with this old craft when I was a boy," he says. People have used oil-paper umbrellas in China __2__ a long time. He has taught his son the craft, and now his son works with him. "Have you __3__ seen an umbrella made by hand?" he asks visitors. Last year, a TV station __4__ a short film about him. Many people watched it, and more visitors have come to his shop since then.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第2空
steps.stem: People have used oil-paper umbrellas in China ______ a long time.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的 a long time：它是一段时间。
steps.explain: a long time 是一段时间，“持续了很久”用 for。

wrong_feedback.A: since 后面跟时间点；a long time 是一段时间，用 for。
wrong_feedback.B: at 后面跟时刻，跟不了“一段时间”，这里用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: from 是“从”，“持续了很长时间”用 for。

steps.reading: Mr Lin makes oil-paper umbrellas in a small town. He has made them __1__ 1985. "I fell in love with this old craft when I was a boy," he says. People have used oil-paper umbrellas in China __2__ a long time. He has taught his son the craft, and now his son works with him. "Have you __3__ seen an umbrella made by hand?" he asks visitors. Last year, a TV station __4__ a short film about him. Many people watched it, and more visitors have come to his shop since then.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第3空
steps.stem: "Have you ______ seen an umbrella made by hand?" he asks visitors.
steps.help: 先想一想：这句是在问“有没有过这个经历”，还是在问“做完没有”。
steps.explain: 问“曾经……吗”（经历）用 ever，放在 have 和过去分词之间。

wrong_feedback.A: never 是“从不”，用在陈述句里表示否定；问经历要用 ever。
wrong_feedback.B: yet 一般放在疑问句的最后（Have you seen it yet?），不放在 seen 前面问经历。
wrong_feedback.D: already 多用在肯定句里表示“已经……”；问经历用 ever。

steps.reading: Mr Lin makes oil-paper umbrellas in a small town. He has made them __1__ 1985. "I fell in love with this old craft when I was a boy," he says. People have used oil-paper umbrellas in China __2__ a long time. He has taught his son the craft, and now his son works with him. "Have you __3__ seen an umbrella made by hand?" he asks visitors. Last year, a TV station __4__ a short film about him. Many people watched it, and more visitors have come to his shop since then.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第4空
steps.stem: Last year, a TV station ______ a short film about him.
steps.help: 先找时间词：这句话说的事情发生在什么时候。
steps.explain: Last year 是明确的过去时间，要用一般过去时 made。

wrong_feedback.A: makes 是现在时三单；Last year 说的是过去的事，要用 made。
wrong_feedback.B: make 是原形，主语 a TV station 是第三人称单数，而且时间是去年，要用 made。
wrong_feedback.C: has made 是现在完成时，不能和 Last year 这种明确的过去时间连用；这里用 made。

steps.reading: Mr Lin makes oil-paper umbrellas in a small town. He has made them __1__ 1985. "I fell in love with this old craft when I was a boy," he says. People have used oil-paper umbrellas in China __2__ a long time. He has taught his son the craft, and now his son works with him. "Have you __3__ seen an umbrella made by hand?" he asks visitors. Last year, a TV station __4__ a short film about him. Many people watched it, and more visitors have come to his shop since then.

steps.title: 挑战 · 问答配对
steps.stem: —How long has Mr Li taught in this school? —______
steps.help: 先分清：问题问的是“多久”（一段时间），还是“何时”（时间点）。
steps.explain: —How long has Mr Li taught in this school? —For ten years.

wrong_feedback.B: In 2015 回答的是“何时”（时间点）；How long 问“多久”，要答一段时间。
wrong_feedback.C: Ten years ago 是“十年前”，是一个时间点，答的是 When 的问题；How long 要答持续的时间段。
wrong_feedback.D: since 后面只能跟时间点，跟不了 ten years 这种时间段；时间段前面用 For。

steps.title: 挑战 · 改写句子
steps.scene: 把前一句改写成用完成时 + since 的句子，只写空里的一个词。
steps.stem: He began to collect stamps in 2018. → He has collected stamps ______ 2018.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的 2018：它是一个时间点。
steps.explain: He has collected stamps since 2018.

common_errors.say: 2018 是时间点，for 后面跟一段时间；时间点用 since。
from 只说从哪开始，“自从那时到现在”用 since。
in 2018 是“在 2018 年”，是过去时的说法；完成时里“自从 2018 年”用 since。
ago 是“以前”，用在过去时里，不能接在 has collected 后面。

steps.title: 挑战 · 当导游多久了
steps.stem: —How long has she been a guide? —______ 2019.
steps.task: 只写 Since 或 For（句首大写）。
steps.help: 先看回答要接的 2019：它是一个时间点。
steps.explain: —How long has she been a guide? —Since 2019.

common_errors.say: 2019 是时间点，For 后面跟一段时间；时间点用 Since。
In 2019 是“在 2019 年”，问的是从那时到现在有多久，用 Since。
from 是“从”，“自从……起”用 Since。

steps.title: 挑战 · 试过赛龙舟吗
steps.stem: ______ your dad ever tried dragon boat racing?
steps.help: 先数一数：主语 your dad 是一个，还是多个。
steps.explain: Has your dad ever tried dragon boat racing?

wrong_feedback.A: your dad 是一人（第三人称单数），现在完成时疑问句要用 Has 开头，不用 Have。
wrong_feedback.C: Is 后面跟不了过去分词 tried 组成完成时；问经历要用 Has。
wrong_feedback.D: Does 后面要跟动词原形 try，跟不了 tried；表示经历的疑问句要用 Has。

steps.title: 挑战 · 保存了十年
steps.scene: 她把这些老照片保存了十年了。
steps.stem: She has ______ the old photos for ten years. (keep)
steps.task: 写出括号里动词的正确形式。
steps.help: 先想：has 后面跟动词的哪种形式；再想 keep 的变化是规则的还是不规则的。
steps.explain: She has kept the old photos for ten years.

common_errors.say: keep 是不规则动词，过去分词是 kept，不能加 ed。
has 后面要用过去分词 kept，不能用原形 keep。
keeping 是现在分词，has 后面用过去分词 kept。
keeps 是三单现在式，has 后面用过去分词 kept。

steps.title: 挑战 · 去了图书馆
steps.scene: 汤姆不在这儿，他去图书馆了，还没回来。
steps.stem: —Where is Tom? —He has ______ to the library.
steps.help: 先看场景：人回来了没有，这决定选 been 还是 gone。
steps.explain: He has gone to the library.（去了还没回来，所以不在这儿。）

wrong_feedback.A: been to 是“去过，已经回来了”；汤姆还没回来，人不在这儿，要用 gone to。
wrong_feedback.B: visit 后面直接跟地点（visit the library），不能加 to；这里要用 gone。
wrong_feedback.C: went 是过去式，不能跟在 has 后面；has 后面要用过去分词 gone。

steps.title: 挑战 · 纸是造出来的
steps.scene: 很久以前，纸是在中国被造出来的。
steps.stem: Long ago, paper ______ in China. (make)
steps.help: 先想：纸是自己出现的，还是被人造出来的；再看时间词 long ago 是现在还是过去。
steps.explain: Long ago, paper was made in China.

common_errors.say: long ago 是很久以前，要用过去时 was made，不用 is made。
少了 be 动词。被动语态 = be 动词 + 过去分词：was made。
make 是不规则动词，过去分词是 made，不能写 maked。
was 后面要用过去分词 made：was made。

steps.title: 挑战 · 粽子被吃掉
steps.scene: 端午节时，粽子被很多人吃掉。
steps.stem: Zongzi ______ by many people during the Dragon Boat Festival.
steps.help: 先想：粽子是吃别人的，还是被别人吃的。
steps.explain: Zongzi are eaten by many people during the Dragon Boat Festival.

wrong_feedback.A: 粽子是被吃的，要用被动语态；eat 是原形，这里要用 are eaten。
wrong_feedback.B: eats 是主动“吃”；粽子不会自己吃东西，要用被动 are eaten。
wrong_feedback.D: are eating 是现在进行时“正在吃”；粽子是被吃的，要用被动 are eaten。

steps.title: 挑战 · 最长的河
steps.stem: Of the three rivers, the Yangtze is ______.
steps.help: 先数一数：一共比了几条河。
steps.explain: Of the three rivers, the Yangtze is the longest.

common_errors.say: 最高级前面要加 the：the longest。
longer 是比较级，只能比两者高低；这里三条河相比，要用最高级 the longest。
long 的最高级是 longest（直接加 est），不用 most long。
原形 long 不能表示“最长”，要用 the longest。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
端午节和造纸术的故事讲完了。How long 问“多久”，你学会了！

下一期是关键：完成时 vs 过去时——“我住过北京”和“我2020年住在北京”，到底有什么不同？
